run_risk_management_agent: run the risk management agent to calculate volatility- and correlation-adjusted position limits for portfolio tickers
calculate_volatility_metrics: calculate daily, annualized volatility and volatility percentile from a price DataFrame
calculate_volatility_adjusted_limit: calculate a position limit percentage based on annualized volatility with bounds between 5% and 25%
calculate_correlation_multiplier: map average correlation between tickers to a risk adjustment multiplier between 0.70 and 1.10
summarize_risk_analysis: summarize risk analysis output including remaining position limits, current prices, and volatility metrics for each ticker
